case.title: The Fed Explained: What the Central Bank Does
case.author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF, copied unchanged and checksum-verified. Page 4 identifies the eleventh edition, August 2021. The Federal Reserve Board annual performance report links this official download.
case.rightsBasis: Federal Reserve Board educational publication, retained as external development material. PDF is not bundled or relicensed under MIT.
case.reviewStatus: Full default conversion passes EPUBCheck and the 768 MiB Mac memory gate. Browser/source spot checks on pages 45 and 46 expose fallback scaling and false headings; ten review pages prepared, full-book fidelity unqualified.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Whole-page raster fallback is displayed too small for normal reading.
Ordinary prose lines become separate h2 headings.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; initial regression ceiling, not a mobile-device budget

rightsClearance.scope: Commercial use and redistribution of the development corpus; retain applicable license attribution.

case.downloadVerification: A fresh download through Tools/fetch_corpus.py matches the owner-supplied identity; see measurements/corpus-downloads/verification.json.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
